focus: Rectangular diagnostic illuminance integration assumptions, SI units/ranges, and analytic/numerical-reference test contract; EmitterFrame basis and SurfacePhotometry clipping internals excluded.
review_method: Remote source and test inspection at the supplied immutable revision through GitHub fetch_file. No repository scripts, build, tests, host commands, source edits, tree changes, or ref changes.

checks.name: Acceptance contract
checks.result: Reviewed m02-m03-code-v2: point analytic error <=1%, declared area numerical-reference error <=5%, preserved Debug/Release tests, documented geometry and units. Static inspection is not gate execution or acceptance.

checks.name: Adapter units and validation
checks.result: StudioPhotometry passes StudioLight.candela as onAxisCandela and widthMeters/heightMeters unchanged to LambertianRectangle. The 0.05...4 meter dimension range and 0...100000 candela range match the callee. Scene positions are finite and bounded to -100...100 meters per component. Receiver direction is camera minus subject, normalized through UnitDirection.

checks.name: Diagnostic geometry and abstention
checks.result: The subject center and camera-facing plane are explicitly documented. Automatic aim follows the subject; manual aim is an absolute position. Invalid light/receiver direction/frame/emitter results propagate nil. The rectangle's public separation contract is max(0.05 meters, longest side/4); StudioOpticsTests exercises abstention with a 2x2 meter emitter at 0.4 meters.

checks.name: Independent centered analytic fixture
checks.result: testRectangleMatchesIndependentAnalyticAndRotatedScene uses half-extents a=0.6, b=0.3, distance=2, intensity=400 cd and the centered parallel-rectangle formula 2*I/area*(a/hypot(d,a)*atan(b/hypot(d,a)) + b/hypot(d,b)*atan(a/hypot(d,b))). Its 800/area coefficient is consistent. The <1% assertion is stricter than the 5% declared-area threshold. This source assertion was reviewed, not executed.

checks.name: Finite area behavior
checks.result: testRectangleNearPlaneAbstainsAndDimensionsChangeEstimate compares different emitting areas at fixed on-axis candela; reduced near-field illuminance for the larger panel is consistent with the declared L=I/area normalization.

checks.name: Metamorphic invariants
checks.result: PhotometryInvariantTests independently composes proper coordinate rotations/translations, tests finite-source inverse-area scaling at fixed candela, and checks mixed studio-rig yaw/translation invariance. Scoped fixtures remain within position/dimension ranges. The studio-rig test explicitly limits the transformation contract to yaw plus translation. These invariants complement absolute reference accuracy; they do not establish that accuracy by themselves.

checks.name: Claims boundary
checks.result: Source documentation distinguishes diagnostic lux from exposure, rendered-face brightness, equipment calibration, and occlusion/reflection effects. Existing milestone status and historical execution claims were not independently revalidated by this review.

limitations: No host/toolchain was available. No tests, scripts, CI, or numerical-reference computation were executed; execution outcomes remain unverified.
Pinned-file review does not inspect current remote branch state, working-tree status, recent commits, or uncommitted work.
EmitterFrame basis correctness and SurfacePhotometry clipping/quadrature internals were outside this worker's assigned scope.
Other area-model numerical-reference tests and runtime artifacts were not audited; the scoped analytic and invariant source checks alone do not establish the full M02 photometry gate.
No physical calibration, device performance, platform audit, or release-readiness conclusion.
conclusion: No new correctness defect or must-fix identified within the assigned static review scope.
